facts.statement: Qianichthyosaurus lived during the Ladinian and Carnian stages of the Late Triassic epoch.
facts.quote: Qianichthyosaurus is an extinct genus of ichthyosaur from the Ladinian and Carnian stages of the Late Triassic epoch.

facts.statement: Fossils of Qianichthyosaurus have been found in the Falang Formation near Huangtutang in Guizhou, southeastern China.
facts.quote: Its fossils have been found in southeastern China, in Carnian rocks of the Falang Formation near Huangtutang, Guizhou.

facts.statement: The type species Qianichthyosaurus zhoui was named by Chun Li in 1999.
facts.quote: The type species is Qianichthyosaurus zhoui, named by Chun Li in 1999.

facts.statement: A second species, Qianichthyosaurus xingyiensis, was named in 2013 by Pengfei Yang and colleagues from Ladinian deposits.
facts.quote: A second species, Qianichthyosaurus xingyiensis, was named from older (Ladinian) deposits in the Falang Formation in 2013 by Pengfei Yang and colleagues.

facts.statement: The species Qianichthyosaurus xingyiensis had a longer snout than the type species.
facts.quote: Between the two species, Q. xingyiensis had a longer snout.

facts.statement: Qianichthyosaurus and its relative Toretocnemus together form the family Toretocnemidae.
facts.quote: The two genera together form the family Toretocnemidae.

facts.statement: Qianichthyosaurus was a small species under 2 meters long with a short snout, large eye orbits, front flippers with three primary digits and four postaxial digits, elongated neural spines on the trunk and tail, and long, thin hemapophyses.
facts.quote: Se trataba de una especie más bien pequeña, de menos de 2 metros de longitud corporal, con hocico acortado, grandes órbitas oculares (rasgo distintivo de los ictiosaurios), aletas delanteras provistas de tres dígitos primarios y cuatro dígitos postaxiales bien desarrollados, espinas neurales alargadas en el tronco y la cola y hemapófisis muy largas y delgadas, rasgos que posee en común con su pariente Toretocnemus, que indica la comunicación durante el Triásico de faunas de ambos lados del Pacífico.

facts.statement: Complete fossils of Qianichthyosaurus are common in the Xiaowa Formation, including juveniles and pregnant specimens.
facts.quote: Complete Qianichthyosaurus fossils are common in the Xiaowa Formation, with both juveniles and pregnant specimens being known

facts.statement: Qianichthyosaurus lived between 239.48 and 227.3 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Ladinian to Carnian (239.48 to 227.3 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Qianichthyosaurus was a small ichthyosaur, with the type species measuring 1.5 to 2 meters long and the second species measuring 1.3 meters long.
rejected.quote: Qianichthyosaurus was a small ichthyosaur, with the type species Q. zhoui measuring 1.5 - 2 m long; Q. xingyiensis was smaller, measuring 1.3 m long.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'was a small ichthyosaur with the type species'

rejected.statement: Both species of Qianichthyosaurus had short, pointed snouts, small teeth, and hind flippers nearly as long as the front flippers.
rejected.quote: Both species had short, pointed snouts, small teeth, and hind flippers that were nearly as long as the front flippers.
